summary: This bill repeals Title IX of the Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002, thereby eliminating Department of Agriculture bioenergy and related subsidy programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly repeals Department of Agriculture bioenergy subsidy programs, which would directly reduce government expenditures. The entire purpose of the bill is to eliminate these spending programs.

The bill consists solely of repealing Title IX bioenergy and related subsidy programs under the 2002 Farm Bill, directly eliminating federal spending on those programs. This is the entire purpose of the legislation, making deficit reduction through spending cuts its central and only effect.
